note: Everything here is synthetic: a fictitious resident and facility, synthetic NPIs absent from the NPI Registry, generic payers, a fixed report template. No patient data.

flow.carries: ADT^A04: who the resident is and what coverage they hold.
OMI^O23 (v2.8) or ORM^O01 (v2.5.1): the exam, its side, the accession, the ordering practitioner and the reason.
DICOM DX: the header repeats the accession, the patient, the body part and the side.
ORU^R01: exam time, report time, final status, the reader.
ServiceRequest, ImagingStudy and DiagnosticReport as R4 resources, sharing the accession.
Service lines: the exam's technical component, set-up, and the transport fee prorated by patients at the stop.

checks.name: The image carries a different accession number from the order
checks.catches: A typo or a swapped study number between the order and the image.
checks.costs: The claim cannot be tied to a valid order, so it is deniable on review.

checks.name: The image's side disagrees with the order
checks.catches: A left knee ordered, a right knee in the header, or no side at all.
checks.costs: The LT/RT modifier on the claim no longer matches the record of what was done.

checks.name: The body part is missing or not a defined term
checks.catches: An empty or non-standard BodyPartExamined tag.
checks.costs: The exam cannot be matched to its procedure code in a documentation review.

checks.name: An image with no order
checks.catches: A study that no order explains.
checks.costs: Work that cannot be billed, or a billed exam with no order behind it.

checks.name: The member ID is wrong
checks.catches: A wrong payer prefix, a failed check digit, another patient's number.

checks.name: Coverage was not in force on the date of service
checks.catches: A claim sent to a plan whose period ended before, or started after, the exam.
checks.costs: The payer denies it; the time to rebill is the cost.

checks.name: The wrong payer
checks.catches: Fee-for-service billed for an Advantage member; Medicaid billed first for a dual-eligible.
checks.costs: A denial, and sometimes a timely-filing loss on the correct payer.

checks.name: The ordering NPI is missing or invalid
checks.catches: A blank, a failed check digit, an organization where an individual is required.
checks.costs: Medicare requires a valid ordering practitioner on the claim.

checks.name: The report is late, early or missing
checks.catches: Turnaround past the service level, a report time before the exam, no report at all.
checks.costs: An exam with no final report is not complete; a late one is a service failure.

checks.name: Views billed differ from views taken
checks.catches: A two-view code on a one-image study, or the reverse.
checks.costs: Over-coding is an overpayment to return; under-coding is money left on the table.

checks.name: The transport line disagrees with the stop
checks.catches: A solo-trip fee at a shared stop, a shared-stop code for one patient, transport on a day with no exam.
checks.costs: The transport fee is prorated by patients served; the wrong code pays the wrong amount.

recall.label: These numbers measure our checks on synthetic data with known planted errors. They are not results from a client.
